dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline exhibiting a distinct inward curvature on the trailing edge from the dorsal ridge junction to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a sharp, low-pixel-radius morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour measured at approximately 65 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Near 1:1 ratio of the fin's maximum pixel base width to its maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a moderate radius visible along the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary, despite high specular glare.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportionally short and thick beak extending from the melon inflection point with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Strong specular highlights and high-contrast lighting saturating the dorsal ridge and lateral flank regions.
